messages:
elaine: Heads up — saw ~20 invoices in NetSuite generated overnight that don't have corresponding charges in Stripe. Reconcile job shows 'webhook processed' but no charge id. Anyone seen duplicate/webhook replay?

sam: @elaine could you paste one or two example invoice IDs? I can grep the webhook and reconcile logs. Also did the webhook consumer return 200 for those events? :eyes: 

elaine: here's one sample: inv_2024_07_31_1234 -> no stripe_charge_id in NS. Reconcile job log snippet:
```
2024-07-31T04:12:22Z reconcile:start invoice=inv_2024_07_31_1234 status=created net_suite_id=NS1234
2024-07-31T04:12:23Z reconcile:warn stripe:lookup failed charge=null error=404
```
Seems like webhook event id evt_1ABC was processed twice, first time created invoice, second time webhook retry created invoice again because idempotency key wasn't set.

stripe-bot: FYI — Stripe shows two delivery attempts for evt_1ABC: attempt=1 status=delivered, attempt=2 status=delivered (retry). Payloads identical; header `Idempotency-Key` absent in both deliveries.

rob: Checking the webhook handler: we set idempotency-key = invoice.external_id when present, but subscription_invoice.finalized uses charge.id which is null for unpaid invoices. That code path falls back to no idempotency key. So on retries the handler treats it as a new create. I'll patch to use event.id as fallback.

jules: Is this related to the NetSuite sync job that maps invoice.external_id? We had a "mapping already exists" trace in netsuite-sync.log earlier this morning.

sam: Pulled the reconcile + sync run. netsuite-sync errored with a duplicate key on external_id. Snippet:
```
psycopg2.IntegrityError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint \"invoices_external_id_key\"
  at execute(...)
```
So the duplicate local invoice was created before sync tried to push to NetSuite.

elaine: We need a mitigation/rollback plan for duplicated NS invoices. Can we mark duplicates as VOID in NetSuite and re-run reconcile? Need approval for API calls in prod. Tagging @jules for ops approval.

jules: Approve cleanup in sandbox now. Prod changes require finance lead sign-off. @ceo (or any finance lead) please confirm next steps. :thinking: 

rob: I'll open a small PR: 1) use event.id as idempotency-key fallback, 2) dedupe in netsuite-sync to ignore pushes when an invoice with same external_id exists, 3) add a reconcile test for duplicate events. Will deploy to staging in ~30m and run the reconcile job against a snapshot.

elaine: Thanks — I'll prepare a list of affected invoice external_ids and draft the NetSuite void requests for the sandbox. Once rob's fix is in staging and we've validated, we can schedule prod patch and a controlled re-run of the reconcile job. :thumbsup:
